items.title: 美銀預測Fed 10月再升息！通膨升溫添變數
items.title_en: BofA Forecasts Another Fed Rate Hike in October as Inflation Heat Up
paras: 《TheStreet》報導，美國銀行(BofA)表示，9月通膨數據意外升溫，進一步強化聯準會(Fed)在10月再次升息的理由。相較於華爾街其他機構及聯準會官員近期相對謹慎的態度，美銀的看法顯得更為急迫。
9月通膨報告再次震撼投資人，也讓聯準會的利率前景更加複雜。
美國消費者物價(CPI)較去年同期上漲3.7%，高於8月的3.4%。扣除食品與能源價格的核心通膨率則達到2.6%。兩項數據都仍高於聯準會2%的通膨目標，不過，聯準會正式衡量通膨時，採用的是個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數。
這足以讓美銀維持原先預測，即使已有不少投資人開始不再看好這項預測。
由Stephen Juneau領軍的美銀分析師團隊重申，由於通膨壓力再度升高，聯準會可能在10月升息。
市場迅速做出反應。截至10月14日，通膨報告公布前，交易員預估聯準會10月升息的隱含機率約為22%。報告公布後，這項機率已升至約47%。
而這次通膨意外升溫，並不只是汽油價格上漲所造成。
美銀真正擔憂的是，9月的價格漲勢同時擴散至商品與服務，使聯準會繼續等待的理由愈來愈難成立。
美銀先前認為，8月通膨意外升溫的情況，大多集中在特定產業，例如無線通訊服務、機票及飯店住宿。
但9月的情況有所不同。美銀指出，價格上漲已擴散至商品與服務，使聯準會更難將這波通膨視為暫時現象而置之不理。
能源價格是最明顯來源。9月CPI中的能源指數大漲5.2%，汽油價格更上漲9.1%。美銀也將機票及租車價格上漲，與伊朗衝突後能源價格走高連結起來。
然而，更令人意外的推手是AI。美銀表示，資料中心需求正外溢至部分使用相同零組件的消費性科技產品。9月資訊科技商品價格上漲0.9%，使當月核心 CPI 增加約0.02個百分點。
高盛也發現 AI 帶來的通膨效應。據《MarketWatch》報導，高盛估計，AI 熱潮使年度核心PCE通膨率增加約0.45個百分點。不過，高盛預期這項影響到了2027年將逐漸減弱。
房市則是另一項複雜因素。9月屋主等價租金（Owners’ Equivalent Rent）上漲0.35%，高於8月的0.19%。美銀並未預測租金將再次大幅飆升，而是認為，先前居住成本通膨放緩的趨勢，大致已經走到尾聲。
綜合上述壓力，美銀將9月核心 PCE 通膨的追蹤估值，從月增0.22%上調至0.32%。
美銀預測10月升息、花旗估12月 Fed官員則籲耐心
儘管美銀認為聯準會即將面臨艱難抉擇，但華爾街並非所有機構都抱持如此急迫的看法。
花旗(Citi)在9月通膨數據高於預期後，調整了利率預測，目前預期聯準會將於12月升息1碼，接著從2027年6月開始降息。
此外，瑞銀(UBS)預測聯準會將在12月及2027年3月分別升息，摩根士丹利的經濟學家也持相同看法。摩根大通財富管理則預期，聯準會還會再升息共0.5個百分點，但升息時間仍存在較大不確定性。
聯準會官員的發言，則提供了另一個保持謹慎的理由。舊金山聯準銀行總裁戴莉（Mary Daly）表示，聯準會沒有迫切需要在10月採取行動，暗示決策官員仍有時間評估接下來公布的經濟數據。
投資人接下來將密切關注通膨與就業數據、能源價格，以及美國公債殖利率的變化，以研判聯準會在10月會議上的決策。
paras_en: TheStreet reports that Bank of America (BofA) says September inflation data unexpectedly rose, further strengthening the case for the Federal Reserve to hike rates again in October. Compared with the more cautious stance of other Wall Street firms and Fed officials, BofA’s view appears more urgent.
The September inflation report shocked investors again and made the Fed’s rate outlook even more complicated.

U.S. consumer price index (CPI) rose 3.7% year‑over‑year, up from 3.4% in August. The core inflation rate, which strips out food and energy, was 2.6%. Both figures remain above the Fed’s 2% inflation target, although the Fed officially measures inflation with the personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index.
This is enough for BofA to stick with its original forecast, even though many investors have begun to doubt it.
Led by Stephen Juneau, BofA’s analyst team reiterated that renewed inflation pressure could prompt the Fed to raise rates in October.

The market reacted quickly. As of October 14, before the inflation report, traders estimated the implied probability of an October hike at about 22%. After the report, that probability rose to roughly 47%.
This surprise inflation surge was not driven solely by higher gasoline prices.
BofA’s real concern is that September’s price gains spread across both goods and services, making it increasingly hard for the Fed to justify waiting.
BofA previously thought the August inflation surprise was concentrated in specific sectors such as wireless communications services, airline tickets and hotel stays.
September was different. BofA said price increases have now spread to a broader range of goods and services, making it harder for the Fed to treat this inflation wave as a temporary blip.

Energy prices were the most obvious driver. The energy component of September’s CPI jumped 5.2%, with gasoline up 9.1%. BofA also linked higher airline ticket and rental‑car prices to the post‑Iran‑conflict rise in energy costs.

A more unexpected driver was AI. BofA said data‑center demand is spilling over to consumer tech products that use the same components. Prices for information‑technology goods rose 0.9% in September, adding about 0.02 percentage points to core CPI that month.

Goldman Sachs also spotted an AI‑related inflation effect. According to MarketWatch, Goldman estimates the AI boom adds roughly 0.45 percentage points to the annual core PCE inflation rate, but expects the impact to taper off by 2027.

Housing added another layer of complexity. Owners’ Equivalent Rent rose 0.35% in September, above August’s 0.19%. BofA does not expect rents to surge again, but believes the earlier slowdown in housing‑cost inflation is largely at an end.
Putting all the pressures together, BofA raised its tracking estimate for September core PCE inflation from a 0.22% monthly increase to 0.32%.
BofA predicts an October hike, while Citi sees a December move and Fed officials urge patience
Although BofA thinks the Fed faces a tough choice, not all Wall Street firms share the same urgency.
Citi, after September’s higher‑than‑expected inflation, revised its rate outlook and now expects a one‑basis‑point hike in December, followed by rate cuts starting in June 2027.

UBS forecasts Fed hikes in December and again in March 2027, and Morgan Stanley’s economists share that view. JPMorgan Wealth Management expects the Fed to raise rates by a total of 0.5 percentage points, though the timing remains highly uncertain.

Comments from Fed officials provide another reason for caution. Mary Daly, President of the San Francisco Fed, said the Fed does not have an urgent need to act in October, suggesting policymakers still have time to assess upcoming economic data.
Investors will closely watch inflation and employment numbers, energy prices, and movements in U.S. Treasury yields to gauge the Fed’s decision at the October meeting.

items.title: 美銀、花旗出手限制AI代理 銀行為何開始害怕「智慧理財」？
paras: 花旗（Citigroup）和美國銀行（BofA）已成為最新一批限制AI代理（AI agents）存取客戶帳戶的美國銀行。近期，多家銀行向監管機構表達擔憂，認為AI代理可能為了追求更高收益而轉移閒置現金，進而導致銀行存款流失。
花旗表示，不允許「第三方AI代理登入客戶帳戶，或直接在我們的數位銀行平台內進行交易」。該行補充說，這項措施旨在保護客戶帳戶及其訊息安全。
美銀執行長Brian Moynihan也暗示，該行正在限制AI代理存取消費者存款，同時制定相關協議，以釐清由AI代理授權的支付最終應由哪一方承擔責任。
本週稍早，Moynihan接受採訪時表示：「我們強烈認為，在資金從你的帳戶轉出之前，應該有人類參與並進行授權。」
他接著說：「你肯定不希望消費者回來告訴我們：『我的帳戶裡有一筆錢被轉走了，我不知道為什麼，也不知道錢去了哪裡，而這一切都是AI代理做的。』」
上月，Meta推出個人AI代理Muse。該產品迅速受到關注，也引發外界擔憂：AI代理可能代表消費者，將大量閒置現金從銀行存款帳戶轉移出去，以尋求更高收益。
Apollo經濟學家Torsten Slok警告，AI代理可能會自動將家庭閒置現金轉入年利率3.3%至5%的帳戶，而美國支票帳戶的全國平均利率僅有0.1%。
摩根大通、美國銀行和富國銀行目前合計持有約1.6兆美元的無息存款，相當於三家銀行負債的16%。如果這些存款需要支付3%的利息，銀行每年將增加約470億美元的利息成本。
如果銀行為了防止零售客戶將資金轉往其他地方賺取更高利率，而被迫提高存款利率，可能對銀行獲利造成重大打擊。
Slok寫道：「如果每個家庭都使用AI代理來最佳化現金餘額的收益率，那麼銀行可能會失去相當大一部分用於支應貸款業務的低成本存款，而這將成為整個金融體系的問題。」
監管機構私下對銀行阻止AI代理存取客戶帳戶的做法表示歡迎。監管官員認為，未來可能需要透過法律進一步釐清兩個問題：

客戶應如何授權自主運作的AI代理代表自己執行金融交易。
如果交易發生問題，究竟應由誰承擔法律責任。


花旗表示，在某些開放銀行服務商的平台上，客戶仍可授權對其帳戶訊息進行有限的唯讀存取。
摩根大通執行長戴蒙（Jamie Dimon）本週也表示，該行將嚴格限制AI代理存取客戶銀行帳戶。
戴蒙表示，「因為你不希望出現失控的AI代理，而且這樣的代理可能會有成千上萬個，我們必須確保以正確的方式保護客戶。因此，我們也正在開發相應的工具。」
他補充，「在此之前，我們不會允許任何外部AI代理隨意進入公司系統，因為這對客戶和摩根大通而言，風險都太高了。」
諮詢公司Simon-Kucher合夥人Christoph Stegmeier表示，銀行將越來越需要尋找方法，透過各種獎勵措施，讓客戶繼續將儲蓄留在銀行。
例如，銀行可以擴大客戶忠誠度計畫，並讓這些計畫影響客戶能獲得的貸款利率等金融產品條件。「你必須讓你的存款產品變得更有黏性。」

items.title: 鄉林賴正鎰：在台房市推案力道將循序加大 明年雙北總銷逾110億元
items.title_en: Xianglin Chairman Lai Cheng-Yi: Project Launches in Taiwan's Housing Market Will Gradually Increase, Total Sales in Greater Taipei Expected to Exceed NT$11 Billion Next Year
paras: AI科技帶動台灣景氣快速成長，包括鄉林(5531-TW)及遠雄(5522-TW)都看好2027年房市景氣的向上格局，鄉林董事長賴正鎰今(17)日指出，預估明(2027)年上半年開始，會看到台灣房市明顯的復甦，真正要好，可能要下半年才會比較明顯，鄉林除明年推案分回總銷110億元的案量之外，在台房市推案量將循序放大。鄉林明年將重心放在雙北住宅，遠雄則力推桃園住宅案。
同時，遠雄建設(5522-TW)在2026年7月已達2025年全年的銷售業績，同時，遠雄房地產總經理張麗蓉也指出，預計在2027年房市將向上，遠雄並將推出桃園、泰山及台南、高雄5大案，合計總銷高達914億元，其中，除新北泰山爲近90億元廠辦案之外，其餘均爲住宅大樓案，而又以上半年重押桃園的體育園區、龜山兩大型建案最受矚目。
鄉林董事長賴正鎰今天在新北市新莊公園路出席「你農我儂・鄉林挺小農」活動後接受訪問時指出，AI科技發展刺激台灣景氣優於歐美，這是民眾共同努力創造的成果；這一定會最後會帶給房地產正面的影響。預估台灣央行有望在這兩、三年慢慢的能夠可能鬆綁，相信下一波的來臨，或許可以創造比現在更優的房市景氣，預期應該慢慢在明年上半年開始看到復甦，真正要好，可能要下半年才會有明確的顯現。
賴正鎰以建案現場來客數爲房市景氣的重要指標，他指出，以前一個案場每週的來客組數最多到20-30組，現在來到差不多10組，預估應該2027年上半年開始會慢慢來到15組，下半年可能來到20組以上，所以這個成交就是看來客量是影響最大，所以就來同數看來爲銷售指標，預估應該2027年下半年慢慢會恢復到趨近於正常，
賴正鎰指出，鄉林在台灣市場方面，雲林斗六「鄉林雲峰」已取得使照並完成對保，目前進入驗屋階段，總銷達28億元，預計12月完成交屋過戶，雖然目 前金融機構審核、排撥房貸趨嚴，但目前雲林斗六「鄉林雲峰」客戶端在取得金融機構房貸都沒有問題。
至於對台灣房市未來的推案量將逐步加大，目前排定2027年的銷售主軸在雙北市，包括台北萬華的2000坪基地都更案，預計鄉林分回60-70億元，至於新北市新莊鴻福段的1005坪基地合建案，即將在12月開案銷售，預計鄉林分回50億元。

2011年於新莊頭前重劃區推出「鄉林淳風」以來，陸續又在推出「鄉林靜安」、「鄉林淳青」、「鄉林淳真」等建案，從住宅開發到社區生活，在新莊累積超過15年耕耘。鄉林重返新莊，即將再度以實際開發行動，繼續深化在地布局與關懷，即將在新莊公園路鴻福段基地推出第五案。鴻福段案，規劃地上24層、地下5層的SRC鋼骨鋼筋混凝土結構大樓，總計 252 戶，主力產品為27至33坪的2、3房，結合 ESG 概念與耐震標章。
paras_en: AI technology is driving rapid growth in Taiwan's economy, and both Xianglin (5531-TW) and Far Eastern (5522-TW) are optimistic about an upward housing market trend in 2027. Xianglin Chairman Lai Cheng-Yi said today (the 17th) that he expects a clear recovery in Taiwan's housing market to begin in the first half of 2027, with a more pronounced improvement in the second half. In addition to targeting total sales of NT$110 billion from projects launched next year, Xianglin will gradually increase its project volume in Taiwan, focusing on residential projects in Taipei and New Taipei, while Far Eastern will push residential projects in Taoyuan.

Far Eastern Construction (5522‑TW) already reached its full‑year 2025 sales target in July 2026. General Manager of Far Eastern Real Estate Zhang Lirong also said the housing market is expected to rise in 2027, and Far Eastern will launch five major projects in Taoyuan, Taishan, Tainan and Kaohsiung, with total sales projected at NT$91.4 billion. Apart from a near‑NT$9 billion office‑industrial project in New Taipei’s Taishan, the rest are residential towers, with the Taoyuan sports park and Guishan large‑scale developments slated for the first half of the year drawing the most attention.

Chairman Lai Cheng‑Yi, speaking after attending the “You Farm, We Farmers – Xianglin Supports Small Farmers” event on Xinzhang Gongyuan Road in New Taipei, said AI technology is boosting Taiwan’s economy beyond that of Europe and the United States, a result of collective effort that will ultimately benefit real estate. He expects the central bank may gradually ease restrictions over the next two to three years, creating a stronger housing market than today. A recovery should become visible in the first half of next year, with a clear upturn likely only in the second half.

Lai uses the number of visitor groups to project sites as a key gauge of market health. He noted that a typical site used to receive 20‑30 groups per week, now down to about 10. He forecasts the figure will rise to around 15 groups per week in the first half of 2027 and exceed 20 groups in the second half, making visitor traffic the most influential sales indicator, with sales expected to return to near‑normal levels by the latter half of 2027.

Lai said Xianglin’s “Yunfeng” project in Douliu, Yunlin has obtained its permit and is now in the inspection stage, with total sales of NT$2.8 billion and expected handover in December. Although financial institutions have become stricter in loan approvals and disbursements, customers of the Yunlin project have so far encountered no issues obtaining mortgages.

Regarding future project volume, Xianglin plans to increase launches step by step, with 2027 sales focused on Greater Taipei. This includes a 2,000‑ping urban‑renewal site in Wanhua, Taipei, expected to contribute NT$6‑7 billion, and a 1,005‑ping joint‑development site in Hongfu, Xinzhang, New Taipei, slated to start sales in December with an anticipated NT$5 billion contribution.

Since launching the “Chun‑Feng” project in Xinzhang’s head‑front redevelopment zone in 2011, Xianglin has added “Jing‑An,” “Chun‑Qing,” and “Chun‑Zhen” developments, accumulating over 15 years of residential and community building in the area. Returning to Xinzhang, Xianglin will again deepen its local presence with a fifth project on the Hongfu site of Gongyuan Road, a 24‑storey above‑ground, 5‑storey underground SRC steel‑reinforced concrete tower comprising 252 units of 27‑33 ping two‑ and three‑room apartments, featuring ESG concepts and a seismic‑resistance certification.

items.title: AI陷入「疲勞交易」！投資人厭倦反覆爭論科技承諾 分析師：市場需要營收證明
items.title_en: AI Falls into 'Fatigue Trading'! Investors Tired of Repeated Debates Over Tech Promises, Analysts Say Market Needs Revenue Proof
paras: 費城半導體指數周五(16日)連續第八個交易日收黑，創18年來最長連跌紀錄，分析師認為，人工智慧(AI)最終可能帶來回報，但投資人已逐漸厭倦反覆討論科技投資的短期回報，以及市場對此抱持的疑慮。
DataTrek Research共同創辦人Nicholas Colas將當前市場走勢稱為「AI疲勞交易」(AI burnout trade)。換言之，投資人對於不斷預測科技投資何時能帶來回報感到厭倦，尤其這些投資的回報時間遙遠且充滿不確定性。他們也厭倦了反覆爭論這些投資對當前市場究竟意味著什麼。
Colas寫道：「標普500指數的投資人，應該關注未來36個月，還是未來10年？我們都知道答案是後者，但一直為前者憂心，可能會讓人筋疲力盡，坦白說情況確實如此。」
Rational Equity Armor Fund共同投資組合經理人Luke Rahbari也表示，投資人正愈來愈難以從AI相關雜音中釐清方向。這些訊息包括AI將帶來革命性成長的遠大承諾、資料中心建置的龐大成本、AI可能取代工作的疑慮，以及幾乎每天都有新的晶片或模型問世。
他認同，許多投資人已厭倦試圖提前數年預測這些投資最終能帶來多少回報。

市場不再只看AI投資規模 要求營收成長證據

過去幾年，企業只要宣布推出更大型的模型、興建更大的資料中心，或加碼AI基礎設施投資，股價往往就能獲得市場獎勵。但StoneX分析師Yi Fu Lee認為，這種情況正在改變，投資人如今要求更明確的證據，證明資本支出能轉化為可持續的營收成長。
金融市場近來對OpenAI與Anthropic等主要私人AI公司的財務指標報告感到不安。Lee表示，當市場預期與實際公布的數據出現落差時，市場可能「毫不留情」，AI相關股票也很快就顯露疲態。
BCA Research首席經濟學家Peter Berezin說，另一項疑慮是，AI代幣(token)的使用支出可能正在放緩。代幣是AI模型處理的資料單位，也是服務供應商計費的依據，若這項支出減速，可能為AI企業帶來挑戰。
根據Berezin的估算，AI企業每年需要創造10兆美元營收，才能讓AI資料中心投資取得「合理的投資報酬率」。

半導體指數連跌8天　CoreWeave成融資疑慮焦點

費城半導體指數(SOX)已連續第8個交易日下跌，並跌至一個月來最低水準。被視為AI借款需求代表企業的CoreWeave(CRWV-US)，股價也跌至7月以來最低點，該公司出租輝達(NVDA-US)的圖形處理器(GPU)，並為OpenAI等AI研究機構提供服務
Lee表示，投資人正逐漸厭倦「憑信念為AI融資」。一旦市場開始質疑企業能否為基礎設施融資，並相信多年後才能實現投資回報，投資人就可能迅速予以懲罰。
Colas也指出，其他因素同樣令投資人不安，例如一般民眾可能根本沒有付費使用AI，或是許多美國人對科技逐漸滲透日常生活，至多只抱持褒貶不一的態度。
Colas寫道：「市場永遠厭惡不確定性，而AI領域的不確定性已經足以引發大量投資人不滿。」不過，他也表示：「在我們看來，這還不足以構成一個令人信服的股市看空理由。」他認為，AI長期而言仍將帶來回報。
paras_en: The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index closed down for the eighth consecutive trading day on Friday (the 16th), setting an 18‑year record for the longest streak of declines. Analysts say AI may eventually deliver returns, but investors are growing weary of repeatedly debating the short‑term payoff of tech investments and the market’s lingering doubts.

DataTrek Research co‑founder Nicholas Colas describes the current market trend as an “AI burnout trade.” In other words, investors are tired of constantly forecasting when tech investments will pay off, especially since the payoff horizon is distant and fraught with uncertainty. They are also fed up with endless arguments about what these investments actually mean for the market today.

Colas wrote: “Should S&P 500 investors focus on the next 36 months or the next ten years? We all know the answer is the latter, but worrying about the former can be exhausting – frankly, that’s exactly what’s happening.”

Rational Equity Armor Fund co‑portfolio manager Luke Rahbari also notes that investors are finding it increasingly difficult to cut through the AI‑related noise. The chatter includes grand promises of revolutionary growth, massive data‑center construction costs, fears that AI could replace jobs, and the near‑daily launch of new chips or models.
He agrees that many investors are tired of trying to predict years in advance how much return these investments will ultimately generate.

The market no longer looks solely at AI investment size; it demands evidence of revenue growth. In past years, companies that announced larger models, bigger data centers, or increased AI infrastructure spending often saw their stock prices rewarded. StoneX analyst Yi Fu Lee believes that is changing – investors now want clear proof that capital outlays can translate into sustainable revenue growth.

Financial markets have recently grown uneasy about the financial metrics reported by major private AI firms such as OpenAI and Anthropic. Lee says that when market expectations diverge from disclosed data, the market can be “relentless,” and AI‑related stocks quickly show signs of fatigue.

BCA Research chief economist Peter Berezin says another concern is that spending on AI tokens may be slowing. Tokens are the data units processed by AI models and the basis for service‑provider billing; a slowdown could pose challenges for AI companies.
Berezin estimates AI firms need to generate $10 trillion in annual revenue for AI data‑center investments to achieve a “reasonable return on investment.”

The semiconductor index has fallen for eight straight days, and CoreWeave (CRWV‑US), seen as a bellwether for AI borrowing demand, has also dropped to its lowest level since July. The company rents NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) GPUs and provides services to AI research outfits such as OpenAI.

Lee says investors are increasingly weary of “financing AI on belief.” Once the market starts questioning whether companies can fund infrastructure and believes returns are years away, investors may swiftly punish them.

Colas also points out other worries, such as the possibility that the general public may not actually be paying to use AI, or that many Americans view the growing tech infiltration of daily life with mixed or ambivalent feelings.

Colas writes: “The market always despises uncertainty, and the uncertainty in AI is already enough to generate significant investor dissatisfaction.” However, he adds: “In our view, that alone does not constitute a compelling bearish case for the stock market.” He believes AI will still deliver returns over the long term.

items.title: 〈友達運動會〉彭双浪：集團朝「類控股」架構轉型 培養小老虎盼成大老虎
items.title_en: AU Optronics Chairman Peng Shuanglang: Group Shifts to a "Quasi-Holding" Structure, Nurturing Small Tigers to Become Big Tigers
paras: 面板大廠友達(2409-TW)今(17)日舉辦集團運動會，適逢成立30週年，董事長彭双浪表示，未來將採取「類控股」架構，透過公司化管理，讓車用、垂直場域等事業的營收與獲利更透明，並培養旗下事業成為具備獨立經營能力的「小老虎」，期許未來各家公司都能成長為大老虎。
彭双浪致詞時表示，今年7月智慧顯示、智慧移動、垂直場域等三大營運支柱及相關負責人已全數到位，將透過各事業的產品力、技術力及管理力，發揮各自所長，帶動集團穩定獲利與成長。此外，技術長帶領的創新研究院將以友達30年累積的技術為基礎，配合AI四支箭布局新技術，盼進一步催生第四、第五個營運支柱。
彭双浪重申，預期到2030年，友達面板直接銷售占比將降至30%，另外70%營收則希望由面板技術延伸出的新平台創造。但這不代表面板製造規模將縮減至目前的30%，預估屆時面板製造能力仍占50%，其中20%將供應集團自身的車用及垂直場域業務，藉此帶動新平台發展。
總經理張博儀補充，友達核心業務仍將聚焦三個營運支柱及創新研究院的新技術布局，對於不在核心策略藍圖內、且經營逐漸成熟的事業，未來不排除讓其獨立發展或上市籌資。例如星耀能源已於今年獨立，未來將朝上市方向發展；其他子公司若達到一定規模與獲利水準，且有外部籌資需求，也可能採取類似方式。
彭双浪表示，三大營運支柱雖然布局不同產業，但仍以面板技術為共同平台，例如AMSC部分業務與Micro LED顯示應用相關，核心技術仍與面板密切連結，若各事業獨立上市，可能因股東組成及利益不同，影響集團整體資源運用。因此，友達將透過公司化管理及清楚的帳務制度，讓投資人每季都能掌握各事業的營收與獲利；共用資源則集中於總部，再依各事業需求配置。
張博儀表示，過去30年面板產業快速發展，但傳統面板產業持續投入大量資本，已愈來愈難有效回收。因此，公司將活化較老舊、缺乏生產效益的廠區，透過汰舊換新或調整資產用途，並將相關產品轉移至六代、七代及八代等較高世代產線，提升產能利用率與整體營運效益，並將資金將優先投入新技術領域。
paras_en: AU Optronics (2409-TW), a major panel manufacturer, held its group sports day today (the 17th) to mark its 30th anniversary. Chairman Peng Shuanglang said the company will adopt a "quasi‑holding" structure, using corporate‑level management to make revenue and profit of its automotive, vertical‑field and other businesses more transparent, and to cultivate its subsidiaries into independently operating "small tigers" with the hope that each will grow into a "big tiger" in the future.

In his remarks, Peng noted that as of July this year the three main operating pillars—smart display, smart mobility and vertical fields—and their responsible leaders are all in place. He said each business will leverage its product strength, technology and management to drive stable profits and growth for the group. In addition, the innovation research institute led by the chief technology officer will build on AU Optronics’ 30 years of technology, aligning with the AI “four‑arrow” strategy to develop new technologies and aim to create a fourth and fifth operating pillar.

Peng reiterated that by 2030 AU Optronics expects direct panel sales to account for only 30% of its revenue, with the remaining 70% generated by new platforms derived from panel technology. This does not mean panel‑manufacturing capacity will shrink to 30% of current levels; the company forecasts that panel‑manufacturing capacity will still represent about 50% of output, with 20% of that dedicated to the group’s own automotive and vertical‑field businesses to support the development of the new platforms.

General Manager Zhang Boyi added that AU Optronics’ core business will continue to focus on the three operating pillars and the new‑technology initiatives of the innovation research institute. For businesses that fall outside the core strategic blueprint and have become mature, the group may allow them to develop independently or seek public‑market financing. For example, Xingyao Energy became independent this year and will move toward an IPO; other subsidiaries that reach a certain scale, profitability and external financing needs could follow a similar path.

Peng explained that although the three operating pillars span different industries, they all share panel technology as a common platform—for instance, some AMSC activities are related to Micro‑LED display applications, and core technologies remain closely tied to panels. If each business were to list separately, differing shareholder structures and interests could affect the group’s overall resource allocation. Therefore, AU Optronics will use corporate‑level management and clear accounting systems so investors can see each business’s revenue and profit each quarter, while shared resources remain centralized at headquarters and allocated according to business needs.

Zhang noted that over the past 30 years the panel industry has grown rapidly, but traditional panel manufacturing continues to require massive capital investment, making effective cost recovery increasingly difficult. Consequently, the company will revitalize older, low‑efficiency factories by replacing outdated equipment or repurposing assets, and shift related products to sixth‑, seventh‑ and eighth‑generation lines to improve capacity utilization and overall operational efficiency, while prioritizing investment of funds into new‑technology areas.

items.title: AI交易平倉潮重創全球避險基金 亞洲基金首當其衝
items.title_en: AI Trading Liquidation Wave Cripples Global Hedge Funds, Asian Funds Hit Hardest
paras: 在多項人工智慧(AI)交易遭大舉平倉衝擊下，全球避險基金本周遭遇沉重損失，以聚焦亞洲市場的基金受創最深。
隨著通膨居高不下、借貸成本維持高檔，投資人愈來愈質疑，鉅額AI投資究竟何時才能帶來回報。美股周五(16日)收盤大幅下跌，CoreWeave(CRWV-US)、博通(AVGO-US)等AI概念股再度遭拋售，油價跳漲也讓交易員在周末前感到不安。
CoreWeave是這波最新賣壓中受創最深的企業之一，這家資料中心營運商的債券本周遭到大舉拋售，殖利率攀升至15%以上。

全球股票多空基金連跌5天 亞洲基金單日重挫2.6%

高盛(Goldman Sachs)主經紀業務部門在致客戶報告中指出，全球基本面股票多空基金——也就是由基金經理人挑選個股的基金——本周每天都賠錢。這類基金在10月15日為止一周內共下跌2.9%，但今年以來仍上漲14.3%。
高盛周五在報告中說：「AI交易周三遭到大幅平倉後，全球股票周四再度遭到賣超，不過速度明顯放緩。這波賣壓仍源自風險部位持續縮減，其中多單賣出規模高於空單回補。」
高盛指出，以美元計算，全球降低總曝險的交易活動——也就是賣出多單與回補空單的總和，在周四的規模約為周三的一半。
高盛並補充，全球AI類股已連續六個交易日遭股票多空基金經理人賣出。
各類策略的避險基金周四都大幅下滑：全球股票多空基金下跌0.9%，其中聚焦亞洲市場的基金下跌2.6%，科技類基金下跌2.0%。全球系統化股票多空基金及多策略基金也分別下跌約1%。
投資避險基金的Erlen Capital Management管理合夥人Bruno Schneller說：「這次發生的情況，與其說是市場從基本面否定AI，不如說是熱門交易部位過度擁擠後，在宏觀經濟現實檢驗下出現典型且快速的平倉潮。美國通膨數據高於預期，迫使市場重新評估利率走勢，立即對AI產業中資本需求最高的領域造成壓力。」

美國通膨推高升息預期 韓股重挫8%

由於美國本周公布的通膨數據提高市場對進一步升息的預期，進而拖累半導體及AI供應鏈類股下跌。半導體類股占比較高的市場承受最大賣壓，南韓KOSPI指數周四重挫8%，收在六個月低點，台股也下跌逾3%。
高盛周四稍早在另一份報告中指出，從新冠疫情期間至2025年底，基本面股票多空、系統化交易及多策略交易這三大類策略，從未在同一天同步下跌超過80個基點(0.8個百分點)。
然而，這種情況今年已發生三次，分別發生在2月4日、7月28日及10月15日。
高盛數據顯示，10月上半月，聚焦亞洲市場的選股基金下跌6.8%，自6月底高峰以來已有超過一半漲幅蒸發。當時這類基金今年來的漲幅一度超過40%。
Schneller說：「這波賣壓有意思的地方，在於它揭露避險基金產業有多大程度上實際押注於同一個核心主題，即使各基金的投資組合表面上看起來截然不同。」
paras_en: Amid a wave of massive liquidations of AI-driven trades, global hedge funds suffered heavy losses this week, with those focused on Asian markets taking the biggest hit.

With inflation staying high and borrowing costs remaining elevated, investors are increasingly questioning when massive AI investments will finally deliver returns. U.S. stocks closed sharply lower on Friday the 16th, and AI‑related names such as CoreWeave (CRWV‑US) and Broadcom (AVGO‑US) were sold off again, while a jump in oil prices left traders uneasy heading into the weekend.
CoreWeave was one of the hardest‑hit companies in the latest sell‑off; the data‑center operator’s bonds were dumped heavily this week, pushing yields above 15%.

Global long‑short equity funds fell for five consecutive days, with Asian‑focused funds plunging 2.6% in a single day. Goldman Sachs’ prime brokerage unit noted in a client report that global fundamental long‑short equity funds – funds that pick individual stocks – lost money every day this week. Over the week ending Oct. 15 they fell 2.9%, though they are still up 14.3% year‑to‑date.

Goldman said in its Friday report: “After AI trades were massively liquidated on Wednesday, global equities saw another wave of selling on Thursday, though the pace slowed noticeably. The pressure still stems from a continued reduction of risk‑on positions, with long‑side selling outpacing short‑side covering.”
Goldman noted that, in dollar terms, the total risk‑reduction activity worldwide – the sum of long sales and short covering – was about half on Thursday of what it had been on Wednesday.
Goldman added that AI‑related stocks have been sold by long‑short equity managers for six straight trading days.

All hedge‑fund strategies fell sharply on Thursday: global long‑short equity funds dropped 0.9%, with Asian‑focused funds down 2.6% and technology funds down 2.0%. Global systematic long‑short equity funds and multi‑strategy funds each fell roughly 1%.

Erlen Capital Management partner Bruno Schneller said, “What we’re seeing isn’t so much the market denying AI on fundamentals as it is a classic, rapid unwind after a crowded hot‑trade position runs into macro‑economic reality. Higher‑than‑expected U.S. inflation forced a reassessment of rate trajectories, immediately pressuring the AI sub‑sectors with the highest capital needs.”

U.S. inflation lifts rate‑hike expectations, South Korean stocks tumble 8%. Because U.S. inflation data released this week raised expectations of further rate hikes, semiconductor and AI‑supply‑chain stocks were dragged down. Semiconductor‑heavy markets bore the brunt, with South Korea’s KOSPI plunging 8% on Thursday to a six‑month low, while Taiwan’s market fell more than 3%.

Goldman earlier on Thursday noted in another report that from the COVID‑19 pandemic through the end of 2025, the three major strategy groups – fundamental long‑short, systematic trading and multi‑strategy – have never on the same day all dropped more than 80 basis points (0.8 percentage points).
However, that scenario has occurred three times this year, on Feb. 4, July 28 and Oct. 15.

Goldman data show that in the first half of October, Asian‑focused stock‑picking funds fell 6.8%, erasing more than half of the gains they had built since the late‑June peak. At that point those funds had been up over 40% year‑to‑date.

Schneller said, “What’s interesting about this sell‑off is that it reveals how much the hedge‑fund industry is effectively betting on the same core theme, even though the portfolios appear very different on the surface.”

items.title: 外資持有美債規模8月回升 加拿大、比利時增最多 中國砍到18年低點
items.title_en: Foreign Holdings of US Treasuries Rise in August, Canada and Belgium Add the Most, China Falls to 2018 Low
paras: 美國財政部周五(16日)公布，外國持有美債規模從2025年10月以來最低水準回升，與7月相比增加逾830億美元，總額升至9.33兆美元，主要由加拿大與比利時增加持有部位帶動。不過，中國持有量降至18年低點。

日本減持360億美元 中國持有量降至18年低點

身為持有美債規模最大的國家，日本8月的持有部位減少360億美元，降至1.1兆美元，創2024年12月以來最低水準。
日本政府今年夏季曾干預外匯市場，在日元兌美元貶至40年來最低水準時買進日元，以提供支撐。日本上月公布的數據顯示，東京當局可能出售一部分的美國公債及其他證券，來籌措干預匯市所需資金。
財政部的報告顯示，持有美債規模排名第三的中國，8月持有量減少270億美元，總額降至5,910億美元，創18年來最低水準。部分分析師指出，北京可能透過加拿大等其他國家進行一部分美國證券交易。

加拿大、比利時增持 英國持有美債首度突破1兆美元

加拿大8月持有美債規模增加380億美元，升抵近4,650億美元。比利時則增加近200億美元，達約4,910億美元。
持有美債規模排名第二的英國，8月持有量增加110億美元，總額首度突破1兆美元。
paras_en: The U.S. Treasury announced on Friday (the 16th) that foreign holdings of U.S. Treasuries have rebounded from their lowest level since October 2025, increasing by more than $83 billion from July and bringing the total to $9.33 trillion, driven mainly by larger positions taken by Canada and Belgium. However, China's holdings fell to an 18‑year low.
Japan, the largest foreign holder of U.S. Treasuries, reduced its position by $36 billion in August, bringing its total down to $1.1 trillion, the lowest since December 2024.

The Japanese government intervened in the foreign‑exchange market this summer, buying yen when the yen‑dollar rate slipped to a 40‑year low to provide support. Data released last month indicate that Tokyo authorities may sell a portion of U.S. Treasury bonds and other securities to raise the funds needed for the currency intervention.

According to the Treasury report, China, which ranks third in Treasury holdings, saw its August holdings drop by $27 billion to $591 billion, the lowest level in 18 years. Some analysts suggest Beijing may be conducting part of its U.S. securities trading through other countries such as Canada.
Canada increased its Treasury holdings by $38 billion in August, bringing its total to nearly $465 billion. Belgium added almost $20 billion, reaching about $491 billion.
The United Kingdom, the second‑largest foreign holder, raised its August holdings by $11 billion, pushing its total past the $1 trillion mark for the first time.

items.title: Roadster讓SpaceX更有價值？特斯拉能分到多少好處？
items.title_en: Does the Roadster Make SpaceX More Valuable? How Much Benefit Can Tesla Capture?
paras: 《Benzinga》報導，特斯拉(Tesla)(TSLA-US)重新設計的Roadster跑車，或許是公司財務貢獻最小、卻最能揭示戰略布局的產品之一。這款車搭載由太空公司SpaceX(SPCX-US)開發的推進器，展現跨越企業界線的工程技術，也引發投資人一個疑問。
如果這項合作強化了SpaceX的技術形象，所創造的經濟價值究竟有多少真正屬於特斯拉？在10月15日的展示中，Roadster運用結合SpaceX技術開發的冷氣體推進器進行空中動作。特斯拉將量產時間訂於2028年，意味著這款車距離對營收產生實質貢獻，仍有數年時間。
這場展示之所以重要，是因為它具體呈現了馬斯克旗下企業如何共享工程技術。特斯拉提供電動車平台，SpaceX則帶來推進技術方面的專業能力。兩者結合可能創造技術優勢，但單憑這場展示，仍無法確定任一家公司究竟能從中獲得多少收益。
據《路透社》報導，馬斯克曾將Roadster形容為「小事一樁」。這項區別很重要：一項產品即使無法成為重要的營收來源，仍可能提升企業的技術聲譽。
價值究竟歸誰所有？
Roadster帶來兩種投資論述。對特斯拉而言，這場展示強化了公司在高階工程技術方面的形象，以及打造能吸引傳統電動車市場以外關注的產品之能力。然而，Roadster屬於利基型車款，預定的量產時間也意味著它距離成為獲利成長的催化劑仍有一段時間。
對SpaceX而言，這項合作展現了其在火箭發射業務之外的推進技術專長，可能進一步強化外界對其工程能力的評價，但這並不會自動轉化為更高的營收、現金流或更具說服力的估值。
目前仍缺少的關鍵資訊，是兩家公司之間的商業安排。現有展示與相關報導並未揭露這項技術的授權費用、智慧財產權歸屬或其他財務條款。在缺乏這些細節的情況下，投資人無法可靠判斷，特斯拉是否能取得經濟利益、SpaceX是否會獲得報酬，或兩家公司是否主要透過共同開發而受益。
當投資人將這項合作解讀為兩家公司可能合併的證據時，這種不確定性就更加重要。共享工程技術平台並不等於合併，而市場對兩家公司合併的猜測，也不能證明交易已經列入計畫。
特斯拉獲利表現仍更重要
特斯拉將於10月21日公布第三季財報，這將為投資人提供比預計2028年才量產的Roadster更即時的業務檢驗。Roadster的亮相重新吸引投資人關注，但股價能否持續上漲，仍取決於特斯拉能否將技術雄心轉化為財務表現。
投資人應關注特斯拉的汽車業務利潤率、交車趨勢及未來營運指引，以判斷公司近期的進展。在兩家公司進一步揭露商業安排之前，Roadster只能證明雙方存在工程技術合作，尚不足以證明特斯拉股東能夠取得由此創造的價值。
paras_en: Benzinga reports that Tesla’s (TSLA‑US) newly redesigned Roadster sports car may be one of the company’s products with the smallest financial contribution yet the most revealing of its strategic layout. The car is equipped with a propulsion system developed by SpaceX (SPCX‑US), showcasing cross‑company engineering and prompting investors to ask a key question.

If this collaboration bolsters SpaceX’s technological image, how much of the economic value created actually belongs to Tesla? In the October 15 showcase, the Roadster performed aerial maneuvers using a cold‑gas thruster developed with SpaceX technology. Tesla has slated mass production for 2028, meaning the vehicle is still several years away from making a material revenue impact.

The showcase matters because it concretely demonstrates how Elon Musk’s companies share engineering know‑how. Tesla provides the electric‑vehicle platform, while SpaceX contributes propulsion expertise. The combination could yield a technical advantage, but the display alone does not reveal how much either firm will ultimately earn.

Reuters reported that Musk once described the Roadster as “a small thing.” That distinction matters: even a product that never becomes a major revenue source can still enhance a company’s technological reputation.
Who ultimately captures the value?

The Roadster supports two investment narratives. For Tesla, the showcase reinforces the company’s image as a high‑end engineering player and its ability to create products that attract attention beyond the traditional EV market. However, the Roadster is a niche model, and its slated production timeline means it remains a distant catalyst for profit growth.

For SpaceX, the partnership showcases its propulsion expertise beyond rocket launches, potentially strengthening external perceptions of its engineering capabilities. Yet this does not automatically translate into higher revenue, cash flow, or a more compelling valuation.

The key missing piece is the commercial arrangement between the two firms. Existing footage and reports do not disclose licensing fees, intellectual‑property ownership, or other financial terms. Without those details, investors cannot reliably assess whether Tesla will earn economic benefits, whether SpaceX will be compensated, or whether both parties primarily profit from joint development.

When investors read the partnership as evidence that the two companies might merge, the uncertainty becomes even more significant. Sharing an engineering platform does not equal a merger, and market speculation about a merger does not prove that such a transaction is being planned.
Tesla’s profit performance remains more important.

Tesla will release its third‑quarter earnings on October 21, giving investors a more immediate gauge of the business than the Roadster, which is not expected to be produced until 2028. The Roadster’s debut has rekindled investor interest, but whether the stock can keep rising depends on Tesla’s ability to turn its technical ambition into financial results.

Investors should focus on Tesla’s automotive profit margins, delivery trends, and future operating guidance to assess near‑term progress. Until the two companies disclose more about their commercial arrangement, the Roadster merely proves an engineering collaboration and is insufficient to demonstrate that Tesla shareholders will capture the value it creates.

items.title: 光通訊水很深 !? 大立光跨足CPO真能變萬金股？美巨頭爆「缺貨率70%」！法人：不只台積電，還有這幾檔吃不完！
items.title_en: Is Optical Communication Really That Deep? Can Largan Precision’s Move into CPO Turn It Into a Billion‑Dollar Stock? US Giant Claims 70% Shortage Rate! Analysts: Not Only TSMC, But These Stocks Are Also Poised for Gains!
paras: 光學鏡頭龍頭大立光(3008-TW)日前召開法說會，董事長林恩平丟下一顆震撼彈：旗下光纖陣列（FA）已順利通過全球大客戶驗證，預計最快明年正式放量生產！
(圖片來源:優分析產業資料庫)
消息一出，外資高盛隨即出具震撼報告，將大立光目標價狂升至不可思議的 11,000 元，「萬金股」傳奇似乎近在眼前。然而，在同一場法說會上，當被問及面板廠試圖以「Micro LED 搭配多模光纖」搶進共同封裝光學（CPO）技術時，林恩平卻冷冷拋出一句「不太可能成真、不看好」，直接引發友達、群創及光通訊族群上詮等個股血流成河，被股民調侃為「別人的法會」。
CPO（共同封裝光學）到底在夯什麼？大立光憑什麼敢搶進？光通訊這塊大餅究竟誰是贏家？
前資深法人操盤手沈萬鈞（萬鈞哥）在優分析節目《股民想知道》中直言：「光通訊是有史以來最容易被誤解、也最容易被誤導的產業！市場目前只看到冰山一角，美國光通訊巨頭甚至已經爆出『70% 的極端缺貨率』，這場剛要爆發的世紀商機，根本不是一兩家廠商吃得完的！」

一、光通訊水有多深？市場雞同鴨講的「三大誤區」
為什麼說光通訊產業「水很深」？沈萬鈞指出，就連許多一般法人研究員，如果不夠深入，都很容易在光通訊領域「雞同鴨講」：
光模塊（Transceiver）與 CPO 傻傻分不清：光模塊是目前伺服器機櫃之間（Server to Server）外接的可插拔光學元件；而 CPO 則是把光學元件直接封裝到晶片身邊，技術難度完全不在同一個量級。
大 CPO（板級）與 晶片端 CPO：光通訊有分 Scale out（機櫃間擴展）、Scale up（機櫃內擴展）以及最極致的 Scale in（晶片與晶片間）。
電傳輸撞牆，光進銅退是物理必然：AI 算力爆發後，銅線傳輸遭遇了無法突破的「物理極限」——訊號衰減嚴重（Loss）、傳輸延遲以及極其恐怖的廢熱。改用光導傳輸訊號，是全世界半導體與 AI 巨頭不可逆的共同終局。
林恩平看衰 Micro LED 方案，並不代表面板廠在說謊，而是光學在不同場景本來就有不同技術路徑與取捨。但這場技術辯論恰恰證明了一件事：所有科技巨頭都急瘋了，不計代價想用光來解決 AI 的傳輸與散熱瓶頸！
paras_en: Largan Precision (3008‑TW), the leader in optical lenses, recently held an earnings briefing where chairman Lin En‑ping dropped a bombshell: its fiber‑array (FA) product has passed verification by major global customers and is expected to begin mass production as early as next year!
(Image source: Youshuo Industry Database)

The news prompted Goldman Sachs to instantly issue a stunning report, raising Largan’s target price to an eye‑popping NT$11,000, making the “billion‑dollar stock” legend seem within reach. Yet, at the same briefing, when asked about panel makers trying to enter the Co‑Package Optics (CPO) field with “Micro‑LED combined with multimode fiber,” Lin coolly replied “unlikely to happen, not optimistic,” sparking a blood‑bath for stocks such as AU Optronics, Innolux and other optical‑communication names, which investors mockingly called “someone else’s ceremony.”
What exactly is CPO (Co‑Package Optics) and why is it hot? What gives Largan the confidence to jump in? Who will win the huge optical‑communication pie?

Former senior institutional trader Shen Wan‑jun (known as “Wan‑jun Ge”) said on Youshuo’s program “What Investors Want to Know”: “Optical communication is the most misunderstood and most easily misled industry ever. The market only sees the tip of the iceberg; a US optical‑communication giant has even disclosed a ‘70% extreme shortage rate.’ This century‑long business opportunity that is about to explode cannot be satisfied by just one or two companies!”

1. How deep is the optical‑communication water? The market’s three major misconceptions. Why is the industry described as “deep water”? Shen points out that even many institutional analysts, if they don’t dig deep enough, end up talking past each other in the optical‑communication field:

Many confuse optical transceiver modules with CPO. A transceiver module is a plug‑in optical component used between server racks (Server‑to‑Server). CPO, on the other hand, integrates the optical component directly next to the chip, a technology challenge on a completely different scale.
Big‑CPO (board‑level) versus chip‑level CPO: optical communication is divided into Scale‑out (between racks), Scale‑up (within a rack) and the most extreme Scale‑in (chip‑to‑chip).

Electrical transmission hits a wall; the shift from copper to light is a physical inevitability. After the AI compute boom, copper wiring faces an unsurpassable physical limit—severe signal loss, transmission latency, and terrifying heat dissipation. Switching to optical signal transmission has become the irreversible end‑game for semiconductor and AI giants worldwide.

Lin’s skepticism toward the Micro‑LED solution does not mean panel makers are lying; optics simply have different technical paths and trade‑offs for different scenarios. However, this technical debate proves one thing: all tech giants are going crazy, sparing no expense to use light to solve AI’s transmission and thermal bottlenecks.

items.title: 美啟動337專利調查，廣達、鴻海、台達電危險了？法人：真正的利空根本不是專利！「這場危機」才可怕！
items.title_en: U.S. Launches 337 Patent Investigation, Are Quanta, Foxconn, and Delta Electronics in Danger? Analysts Say the Real Bad News Isn’t the Patent Issue! The “Crisis” Is What’s Truly Scary!
paras: 近日科技圈投下一枚震撼彈！美國國際貿易委員會（ITC）宣布對特定電源設備及相關零組件啟動「337調查」，涉案名單赫然出現台灣科技三雄——鴻海(2317-TW)、廣達(2382-TW)、台達電(2308-TW)。
消息一出，不少散戶投資人嚇出一身冷汗：「這是不是美國要修理台廠了？」、「手上的 AI 伺服器飆股會不會變『法會』？」
然而，市場盤面給出的反應卻異常平靜，甚至股價連大跌的跡象都沒有。究竟是市場反應遲鈍，還是內行法人看到了散戶沒注意到的盲點？
前資深法人操盤手沈萬鈞（萬鈞哥）在優分析的《股民想知道》中一語道破：「專利調查只是雜音，現在法人眼中真正的實質利空，根本不是 337 條款，而是另一場即將席捲 AI 產業鏈的嚴峻危機！」

一、337調查是致命傷？法人：台廠護城河深不可測
面對美國 ITC 的專利調查，散戶第一時間往往聯想到禁售、罰款等利空，但法人機構在評估這項風險時，卻顯得老神在在。
沈萬鈞指出，從歷史經驗與產業結構來看，這次的影響微乎其微，原因在於：
台廠龍頭地位無可取代：以電源供應器為例，台達電已經連續 25 年穩坐全球霸主寶座；就連全球第二大廠，也是台灣的光寶科，根本不是美國本土企業。
製造與量產能力的「絕對門檻」：專利技術固然有部分源自美國早期開發，但「能夠規模化、高良率、極致成本控制」把產品量產出來的，全世界只有台廠供應鏈辦得到。
商業訴訟常態化：在科技產業中，伴隨巨額商機而來的專利戰向來是競爭對手的「例行公事」，通常最終多以交叉授權、和解或支付微幅權利金收場，幾乎不可能阻斷台廠出貨。
換句話說，美系科技巨頭（如微軟、Google、Meta、AWS）急著蓋 AI 資料中心，根本承擔不起廣達、鴻海、台達電斷供的代價。
paras_en: A shocking bomb has just been dropped in the tech world: the U.S. International Trade Commission (ITC) announced a “337 investigation” into certain power supplies and related components, and the list of companies under scrutiny includes Taiwan’s three tech giants—Foxconn (2317‑TW), Quanta (2382‑TW), and Delta Electronics (2308‑TW).
When the news broke, many retail investors broke out in a cold sweat: “Is the U.S. trying to punish Taiwanese factories?” “Will the AI‑server stocks I hold turn into a disaster?”

Yet the market’s reaction has been unusually calm, with no sign of a sharp sell‑off. Is the market simply slow to respond, or have institutional investors spotted a blind spot that retail investors missed?

Veteran institutional trader Shen Wan‑jun (known as “Wan‑jun Ge”) cut through the noise in a U‑Analysis “What Investors Want to Know” piece, saying: “The patent probe is just background noise. The real substantive downside that institutions see is not the 337 provision at all, but another severe crisis that is about to sweep the AI supply chain!”

1. Is the 337 probe a fatal blow? Institutions say Taiwanese firms have an almost impenetrable moat. When faced with an ITC patent investigation, retail investors immediately think of bans, fines and other negative fallout, but institutional analysts evaluate the risk with far more confidence.
Shen Wan‑jun points out that, based on historical experience and industry structure, the impact of this particular probe will be negligible, for several reasons:

Taiwan’s leading‑player status is irreplaceable: take power‑supply units as an example—Delta Electronics has held the global top spot for 25 consecutive years, and even the world’s second‑largest supplier, Taiwan’s Lite‑On, is not a U.S. company.

The “absolute barrier” of manufacturing and mass‑production capability: while some patented technologies originated in early U.S. development, only Taiwan’s supply chain can scale production with high yield and extreme cost control, turning those patents into mass‑produced products.

Litigation is routine in the tech sector: massive patent battles are a normal part of competition, usually ending in cross‑licensing, settlements or modest royalty payments, and they almost never halt shipments from Taiwanese manufacturers.
In other words, U.S. tech giants such as Microsoft, Google, Meta, and AWS are racing to build AI data centers and simply cannot afford a supply cut from Quanta, Foxconn, or Delta Electronics.

items.title: 記憶體、ABF、CCL明年繼續缺？毛利率20%衝向50%！法人曝資金大搬風內幕：現在買「這族群」動能最強！
items.title_en: Will Memory, ABF, and CCL Still Face Shortages Next Year? Gross Margins Jump from 20% to 50%! Insiders Reveal Massive Capital Shifts: Now is the Best Time to Buy This Sector
paras: 許多投資人在今年下半年的操作中，常產生一股巨大的「不公平感」：
「明明看著記憶體大廠繳出亮眼成績單、毛利率飆上 80%，股價卻在原地盤整，甚至連拉一根漲停板都困難；反觀先前被唱衰的 ABF 載板、CCL（高階銅箔基板），股價卻強勢上攻、頻創新高？」
同樣都搭上 AI 缺貨題材，為什麼法人資金會出現如此劇烈的「差別待遇」？
前資深操盤手沈萬鈞（萬鈞哥）在優分析節目《股民想知道》中揭開了機構法人的底層操盤邏輯：「明年缺料確定會繼續缺，但真正主導股價爆發力的，不是公司現在賺多少錢，而是誰的『毛利率擴張動能』最兇悍！」

一、定調明年供應鏈：不是不缺，而是「缺貨繼續缺」！
回顧這波 AI 狂潮，從 2023 年底開始，法人圈在每週、每月的密集產業會議中，就已經敏銳捕捉到銅箔基板、ABF 載板及記憶體開始吃緊的早期訊號。果不其然，2024 年一整年，幾乎所有大漲特漲的標的都緊扣著「缺貨」主軸。
展望未來，這場由 AI 伺服器引爆的零組件荒結束了嗎？
沈萬鈞斬釘截鐵地表示：「明年缺貨絕對會繼續缺！」
記憶體（DRAM/HBM）：隨著次世代 AI 晶片算力攀升，明年的吃緊程度甚至會比今年更誇張。
光通訊與被動元件：以美國光學巨頭 Lumentum 為例，法說會直接揭露部分關鍵產品「缺貨率高達 70%」。
ABF 與 CCL：高階多層板材料依然是先進封裝與高階伺服器的主要瓶頸。
但既然全面都在缺，為何股價表現卻走向兩個極端？這牽涉到法人資金的「挑剔本質」。

二、法人心機大解密：為什麼買 ABF、CCL，不買記憶體？
許多散戶看不懂，南亞科(2408-TW)第二季毛利率飆到 79%、第三季進一步衝上 86%～87%，業績好到無懈可擊，為什麼法人反而把大筆銀彈砸向 ABF 與 CCL？
(圖片來源:優分析產業資料庫)

1. 「80% 的天花板」vs「從 20% 衝向 50% 的動能」
法人操盤追逐的是**「變化的斜率（成長動能）」，而非「絕對數字」**：
記憶體的尷尬：毛利率已經來到 85% 以上，散戶覺得很賺，但在精明的法人眼裡，這意味著「獲利能力已經接近天花板，未來很難再往上給市場驚喜」。
ABF 載板的爆發力：ABF 三雄（欣興、南電、景碩）第二季毛利率多數還趴在 20% 多的低檔。但在產能嚴重吃緊、漲價效應逐步浮現的預期下，市場預期其毛利率極可能一口氣拉升至 50% 甚至更高！
(圖片來源:優分析產業資料庫)
「從 20% 衝到 50%，這整整翻了一倍以上的爆發力，才是法人最願意掏出溢價買單的『成長動能』！」 沈萬鈞分析。

2. 背後買盤的屬性完全不同
這並不代表記憶體沒有人買，而是買家屬性徹底變了：
買記憶體的資金：主要是高股息 ETF 或穩健型長線資金。這類資金講求防禦與殖利率，操作節奏是「跌下來慢慢撿」，絕不會去幫散戶拉抬漲停板。
買 CCL 與 ABF 的資金：是追求超額報酬的「動能型法人、避險基金、主動型 ETF」。這批聰明錢要的是短期內業績跳升帶來的戴維斯雙擊（EPS 與本益比同步調升），因此股價拉抬的速度與氣勢自然完全不同。
paras_en: Many investors have felt a huge sense of "unfairness" in their trading during the second half of this year:

"Even though the big memory manufacturers are posting impressive results, with gross margins soaring to 80%, their stock prices are stuck in a sideways range, struggling even to hit a single limit-up; meanwhile, the previously despised ABF substrates and CCL (high‑end copper foil substrates) are surging upward and repeatedly hitting new highs?"
Both groups are riding the AI shortage theme, so why is institutional capital treating them so differently?

Former senior trader Shen Wan‑jun (known as "Wan‑jun Ge") explained the underlying logic of institutional trading on the You Analysis program "What Investors Want to Know": "Next year’s material shortages will definitely continue, but the real driver of stock price explosions isn’t how much money a company is making now, it’s whose ‘gross‑margin expansion momentum’ is the fiercest!"

1. Setting the tone for next year’s supply chain: it’s not that there won’t be shortages, but that “shortages will keep persisting”! Looking back at this wave of AI frenzy, since the end of 2023 institutional circles have been picking up early signals of tightening for copper‑foil substrates, ABF substrates and memory chips in weekly and monthly industry meetings. Unsurprisingly, throughout 2024 almost every stock that rallied sharply was tied to the “shortage” theme.
Looking ahead, has the component shortage sparked by AI servers finally ended?
Shen Wan‑jun stated unequivocally: "Shortages will absolutely continue next year!"
Memory (DRAM/HBM): As next‑generation AI chips demand ever‑higher compute power, the tightness next year will be even more dramatic than this year.
Optical communications and passive components: taking U.S. optics giant Lumentum as an example, its earnings call disclosed that some key products have a shortage rate as high as 70%.
ABF and CCL: high‑end multilayer board materials remain the main bottleneck for advanced packaging and high‑end servers.
But if everything is in short supply, why do stock performances diverge to two extremes? This ties back to the “picky nature” of institutional capital.

2. Decoding institutional motives: why buy ABF and CCL but not memory? Many retail investors don’t understand why Nanya Technology (2408‑TW) saw its Q2 gross margin jump to 79% and climb further to 86‑87% in Q3—performance that seems flawless—yet institutions are pouring large sums into ABF and CCL instead.
(Image source: You Analysis industry database)
1. "80% ceiling" vs "momentum from 20% to 50%" Institutional traders chase **"the slope of change (growth momentum)"**, not the absolute numbers:

The awkwardness of memory: margins have already topped 85%, which retail investors see as very profitable, but savvy institutions view this as "profitability is near the ceiling, leaving little room for future surprises for the market."

ABF substrate explosiveness: the three ABF leaders (Unimicron, Nan Ya, and Jingshuo) posted Q2 gross margins mostly stuck in the low‑20% range. However, with capacity tightening severely and price‑rise effects beginning to surface, the market expects their margins could surge to 50% or even higher in one go.
(Image source: You Analysis industry database)
"Jumping from 20% to 50%—that's more than a double‑fold explosion of margin—that’s the ‘growth momentum’ institutions are most willing to pay a premium for," Shen Wan‑jun analyzed.
2. The buyer profiles are completely different This doesn’t mean nobody buys memory; it means the type of buyer has fundamentally changed:

Capital buying memory: mainly high‑dividend ETFs or conservative long‑term investors. These funds prioritize defense and yield, operating with a "buy the dip slowly" rhythm and never push stocks to hit limit‑up levels for retail investors.

Capital buying CCL and ABF: consists of "momentum‑driven institutions, hedge funds, and active ETFs" seeking excess returns. This smart money chases the short‑term earnings jump that creates a Davis double‑hit (simultaneous EPS and P/E upgrades), so the speed and force of price lifts are naturally on a completely different level.

paras: AMD（超微）董事長兼執行長蘇姿丰日前再度造訪台灣。這趟行程極度緊湊，堪稱「快閃 24 小時」的旋風式巡禮——在短短一天內，她馬不停蹄地接連拜訪了鴻海、廣達、華碩、宏碁以及護國神山台積電，甚至宣布加碼在台投資。

paras_en: AMD (Advanced Micro Devices) chairman and CEO Su Zifeng recently visited Taiwan again. The itinerary was extremely tight, a "flash 24‑hour" whirlwind tour—within a single day she raced from one meeting to the next, visiting Foxconn, Quanta, Asus, Acer and the national treasure TSMC, and even announced an increase in investment on the island.

A top‑level CEO who controls a chip empire worth several hundred billion dollars, why would she carve out a 24‑hour slot in an already jam‑packed schedule to fly to Taiwan in person and "plant a stake"?

items.title: 鄉林賴正鎰：在台房市推案力道將循序加大 明年雙北總銷逾110億元
items.title_en: Xianglin Chairman Lai Cheng-Yi: Project Launches in Taiwan's Housing Market Will Gradually Increase, Total Sales in Greater Taipei Expected to Exceed NT$11 Billion Next Year
paras: AI科技帶動台灣景氣快速成長，包括鄉林(5531-TW)及遠雄(5522-TW)都看好2027年房市景氣的向上格局，鄉林董事長賴正鎰今(17)日指出，預估明(2027)年上半年開始，會看到台灣房市明顯的復甦，真正要好，可能要下半年才會比較明顯，鄉林除明年推案分回總銷110億元的案量之外，在台房市推案量將循序放大。鄉林明年將重心放在雙北住宅，遠雄則力推桃園住宅案。
同時，遠雄建設(5522-TW)在2026年7月已達2025年全年的銷售業績，同時，遠雄房地產總經理張麗蓉也指出，預計在2027年房市將向上，遠雄並將推出桃園、泰山及台南、高雄5大案，合計總銷高達914億元，其中，除新北泰山爲近90億元廠辦案之外，其餘均爲住宅大樓案，而又以上半年重押桃園的體育園區、龜山兩大型建案最受矚目。
鄉林董事長賴正鎰今天在新北市新莊公園路出席「你農我儂・鄉林挺小農」活動後接受訪問時指出，AI科技發展刺激台灣景氣優於歐美，這是民眾共同努力創造的成果；這一定會最後會帶給房地產正面的影響。預估台灣央行有望在這兩、三年慢慢的能夠可能鬆綁，相信下一波的來臨，或許可以創造比現在更優的房市景氣，預期應該慢慢在明年上半年開始看到復甦，真正要好，可能要下半年才會有明確的顯現。
賴正鎰以建案現場來客數爲房市景氣的重要指標，他指出，以前一個案場每週的來客組數最多到20-30組，現在來到差不多10組，預估應該2027年上半年開始會慢慢來到15組，下半年可能來到20組以上，所以這個成交就是看來客量是影響最大，所以就來同數看來爲銷售指標，預估應該2027年下半年慢慢會恢復到趨近於正常，
賴正鎰指出，鄉林在台灣市場方面，雲林斗六「鄉林雲峰」已取得使照並完成對保，目前進入驗屋階段，總銷達28億元，預計12月完成交屋過戶，雖然目 前金融機構審核、排撥房貸趨嚴，但目前雲林斗六「鄉林雲峰」客戶端在取得金融機構房貸都沒有問題。
至於對台灣房市未來的推案量將逐步加大，目前排定2027年的銷售主軸在雙北市，包括台北萬華的2000坪基地都更案，預計鄉林分回60-70億元，至於新北市新莊鴻福段的1005坪基地合建案，即將在12月開案銷售，預計鄉林分回50億元。

2011年於新莊頭前重劃區推出「鄉林淳風」以來，陸續又在推出「鄉林靜安」、「鄉林淳青」、「鄉林淳真」等建案，從住宅開發到社區生活，在新莊累積超過15年耕耘。鄉林重返新莊，即將再度以實際開發行動，繼續深化在地布局與關懷，即將在新莊公園路鴻福段基地推出第五案。鴻福段案，規劃地上24層、地下5層的SRC鋼骨鋼筋混凝土結構大樓，總計 252 戶，主力產品為27至33坪的2、3房，結合 ESG 概念與耐震標章。
paras_en: AI technology is driving rapid growth in Taiwan's economy, and both Xianglin (5531-TW) and Far Eastern (5522-TW) are optimistic about an upward housing market trend in 2027. Xianglin Chairman Lai Cheng-Yi said today (the 17th) that he expects a clear recovery in Taiwan's housing market to begin in the first half of 2027, with a more pronounced improvement in the second half. In addition to targeting total sales of NT$110 billion from projects launched next year, Xianglin will gradually increase its project volume in Taiwan, focusing on residential projects in Taipei and New Taipei, while Far Eastern will push residential projects in Taoyuan.

Far Eastern Construction (5522‑TW) already reached its full‑year 2025 sales target in July 2026. General Manager of Far Eastern Real Estate Zhang Lirong also said the housing market is expected to rise in 2027, and Far Eastern will launch five major projects in Taoyuan, Taishan, Tainan and Kaohsiung, with total sales projected at NT$91.4 billion. Apart from a near‑NT$9 billion office‑industrial project in New Taipei’s Taishan, the rest are residential towers, with the Taoyuan sports park and Guishan large‑scale developments slated for the first half of the year drawing the most attention.

Chairman Lai Cheng‑Yi, speaking after attending the “You Farm, We Farmers – Xianglin Supports Small Farmers” event on Xinzhang Gongyuan Road in New Taipei, said AI technology is boosting Taiwan’s economy beyond that of Europe and the United States, a result of collective effort that will ultimately benefit real estate. He expects the central bank may gradually ease restrictions over the next two to three years, creating a stronger housing market than today. A recovery should become visible in the first half of next year, with a clear upturn likely only in the second half.

Lai uses the number of visitor groups to project sites as a key gauge of market health. He noted that a typical site used to receive 20‑30 groups per week, now down to about 10. He forecasts the figure will rise to around 15 groups per week in the first half of 2027 and exceed 20 groups in the second half, making visitor traffic the most influential sales indicator, with sales expected to return to near‑normal levels by the latter half of 2027.

Lai said Xianglin’s “Yunfeng” project in Douliu, Yunlin has obtained its permit and is now in the inspection stage, with total sales of NT$2.8 billion and expected handover in December. Although financial institutions have become stricter in loan approvals and disbursements, customers of the Yunlin project have so far encountered no issues obtaining mortgages.

Regarding future project volume, Xianglin plans to increase launches step by step, with 2027 sales focused on Greater Taipei. This includes a 2,000‑ping urban‑renewal site in Wanhua, Taipei, expected to contribute NT$6‑7 billion, and a 1,005‑ping joint‑development site in Hongfu, Xinzhang, New Taipei, slated to start sales in December with an anticipated NT$5 billion contribution.

Since launching the “Chun‑Feng” project in Xinzhang’s head‑front redevelopment zone in 2011, Xianglin has added “Jing‑An,” “Chun‑Qing,” and “Chun‑Zhen” developments, accumulating over 15 years of residential and community building in the area. Returning to Xinzhang, Xianglin will again deepen its local presence with a fifth project on the Hongfu site of Gongyuan Road, a 24‑storey above‑ground, 5‑storey underground SRC steel‑reinforced concrete tower comprising 252 units of 27‑33 ping two‑ and three‑room apartments, featuring ESG concepts and a seismic‑resistance certification.

items.title: 鄉林賴正鎰：挺小農是企業責任 也是居民可參與的一畝田生活體驗
